requirement_vague: Verify following a user updates the profile following status correctly and prevents self-following

omissions.description: POST /api/profiles/{username}/follow does not return HTTP status 201; it returns the default 200.
omissions.reasoning: The follow_user route is defined with @app.post('/api/profiles/{username}/follow') but no status_code=201 is specified, so FastAPI defaults to 200. The requirement expects a 201 response.

omissions.description: Self-follow attempt does not return HTTP 400 with a message containing 'cannot be equal'; instead it silently succeeds with a 200 response.
omissions.reasoning: In follow_user, when current_user.id == target.id, the code simply skips adding the FollowLink and returns the profile with status 200. There is no HTTPException raised with status 400 or any message containing 'cannot be equal'.
